caption: Brightness of the gray patches in the image (0% black, 100% white)

tooDark.label: Brightness too low
tooDark.hint: Add light or raise the camera exposure.

tooBright.label: Brightness too high
tooBright.hint: Dim the light or lower the camera exposure.

highContrast.label: Contrast too high
highContrast.hint: Lower the camera contrast or use softer light.

issue.bothClipped: Lower the contrast, light the card more evenly, avoid reflections on it.
